'''Cuffbands''', also '''restraining bands''', were a type of personal restraining device, similar to [[Binders/Legends|binders]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] once restrained the [[Human replica droid]] [[Guri]] by binding her wrists with cuffbands. Guri, however, merely used her brute [[Droid/Legends|droid]] strength to break out of her restraints.
